scheduling.skill_goal: Translate and localize Office documents (PPTX/DOCX/PDF/XLSX) while preserving original templates and formatting.

capability_candidates.name: Translate PPTX document
capability_candidates.description: Translate a PPTX presentation's text content while preserving original templates and styles by editing XML text nodes.
matched_terms: PPTX全文翻译 / Full PPTX translation

preconditions.text: Input file is a valid PPTX (ZIP archive containing ppt/slides/*.xml)

structural.text: Output .pptx file exists at specified --output path
Output PPTX retains original template/style structure (theme, content types)

semantic.text: Text content in <a:t> nodes is translated from source to target language

common_failure_modes.text: Medical/technical terms freely translated by AI instead of using manual mapping table
Trademarks/brand names (e.g. Medtronic, Harmonic) get translated instead of being kept original
Numbers+units (e.g. 7mm, 150 procedures) altered instead of kept as-is
Footnote symbols († ‡ § Ω) modified instead of preserved

capability_candidates.name: Translate DOCX document
capability_candidates.description: Translate a DOCX Word document's text content while preserving original styles by editing XML text nodes in word/document.xml.
matched_terms: DOCX全文翻译 / Full DOCX translation

preconditions.text: Input file is a valid DOCX (ZIP archive containing word/document.xml)

structural.text: Output .docx file exists at specified --output path
Output DOCX retains original styles (word/styles.xml preserved)

semantic.text: Text content in <w:t> nodes is translated to target language

common_failure_modes.text: Medical/technical terms freely translated instead of using manual mapping table
Trademarks/brand names translated instead of preserved
Numbers+units altered instead of kept as-is
Footnote symbols modified instead of preserved

capability_candidates.name: Translate XLSX spreadsheet
capability_candidates.description: Translate an XLSX spreadsheet's cell text content while preserving original styles by editing the shared strings table.
matched_terms: XLSX全文翻译 / Full XLSX translation

preconditions.text: Input file is a valid XLSX (ZIP archive containing xl/worksheets and xl/sharedStrings.xml)

structural.text: Output .xlsx file exists at specified --output path
Output XLSX retains original styles (xl/styles.xml preserved)

semantic.text: Cell text from sharedStrings.xml is translated to target language

common_failure_modes.text: Medical/technical terms freely translated instead of using manual mapping table
Trademarks/brand names translated instead of preserved
Numbers+units altered instead of kept as-is

capability_candidates.name: Translate PDF document
capability_candidates.description: Translate a PDF's text content by extracting with pdfplumber and rebuilding via Word→PDF (Method A) or direct overlay for text-layer PDFs (Method B).
matched_terms: PDF全文翻译 / Full PDF translation

preconditions.text: When --method direct is used, the PDF must be a text-layer PDF
Method A requires pdfplumber, python-docx, and LibreOffice
Method B requires pdfplumber and pypdf2

structural.text: Output .pdf file exists at specified --output path

semantic.text: Extracted PDF text is translated to target language in the output PDF

common_failure_modes.text: Using --method direct on a non-text-layer PDF (only text-layer PDFs supported)
Medical/technical terms freely translated instead of using manual mapping table
Trademarks/brand names translated instead of preserved
Numbers+units altered instead of kept as-is
